title: tailored-quant-profiles-validation-plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Define and validate per-model default quantization profiles for the Model Catalog so that the recommended profile (FP8/INT8 variant + calibration parameters) minimizes cost while keeping model behavior within defined accuracy guardrails. This ticket scopes the engineering work for an automated calibration + validation pipeline, the acceptance criteria for promotion to the catalog UI, and fallback/rollback guardrails for runtime serving. Deliverables: (1) a calibration workflow that runs per-model and produces a recommended default profile, (2) a set of quantitative and qualitative validation checks, (3) an integration path to publish defaults in the catalog with metadata and telemetry hooks.
tasks: Design calibration dataset selection: representative prompt shards + stratified sampling across token lengths and domains
Implement calibration runner that tries FP8 and INT8 profiles with configurable per-channel/per-tensor modes
Add activation clipping and outlier handling knobs (percentile-based) to the calibration pipeline
Create validation harness to compare candidate quant profiles vs floating-point baseline using n_eval metrics
Define accuracy guardrails and regression thresholds for automatic approval/flagging
Integrate calibration job results into Model Catalog metadata + UI fields (recommended_profile, observed_regressions, calibration_artifact_url)
Add CI gating: calibration + validation must pass on release branches for catalog promotion
Add rollout policy: default profile promoted to hosted models with canary traffic and automatic fallback to higher-precision variant if degradation observed
acceptance_criteria: For each candidate model, the pipeline outputs a recommended_profile string (e.g., "FP8-A2" or "INT8-per-channel") and a calibration_artifact_url
Quantized model passes numerical accuracy checks: top-line metric regression <= 1.0% relative to fp32 baseline on stratified eval sets
Behavioral checks: no statistically significant increase in hallucination rate on 3 benchmark suites (knowledge, instruction, code) at p<0.05
Performance checks: per-token latency within SLO when running at catalog-configured batch sizes on QA hardware
Telemetry hooks are emitted: calibration_summary, validation_report, and chosen_profile logged for audit
Catalog UI displays recommended_profile, expected cost delta, and a one-line guardrail summary after promotion
notes: Trade-offs: FP8 often yields larger cost wins but is more sensitive to activation outliers; INT8 per-channel is more robust for decoder attention-heavy models
Calibration budget: initial experiments will run with 5k representative prompts per model; we may reduce to 1k stratified shards for very large catalogs
Calibration data governance: must avoid customer PII — use synthetic augmentation and internal prompt corpus
When models show >1% regression on core metrics, we will attempt: per-channel quant, larger calibration sample, dynamic range clipping before rejecting profile
Edge case: models using custom ops (flash-attn variants) may require special kernel builds to run INT8; flag those models in catalog
